title: Meet VOOL at Elmässan Expo in Sweden
seoTitle: Meet VOOL at Elmässan Expo Stockholm 2024
description:
Elmässan Expo takes place on 16-17 October 2024 in Stockholm. 
VOOL will be there with our complete EV charging solution that includes a smart EV charger, Load Management Controller, admin Portal for property managers and free Mobile App for end users.
body:
Hej Sverige! Nice to see you again!

VOOL will be attending the Elmässan Expo on 16-17 October 2024 in Stockholm, Sweden. Meet us in our booth H:20!

We'll bring along our complete EV charging solution with our in-house developed hardware and software.

Complete EV Charging Solution for Homes and Businesses

VOOL is the complete EV charging solution that fits both private and commercial needs. Our technology enables to use the existing grid connection up to three times more efficiently without expensive grid infrastructure upgrades or causing grid overload.

We do this through automatic phase switching and dynamic load management technologies. For apartment buildings and row houses, we've developed Multi Point Load Management to ensure seamless charger integration into the electrical system. Our technology will work in the background; chargers and Load Management Controller will communicate to ensure that the property's electricity will not fail.

VOOL 22kW EV charger is perfect for charging at home and in the office

VOOL EV charger with matte black cover

VOOL product line-up includes an EV charger that fits anyone, anything and anywhere. It comes with a Type 2 plug, charges any electric car and can be installed on a wall, on a post. The VOOL charger is chic and timeless. You can choose a case design that best suits your location – matte black plastic, natural wood, brushed aluminium or real moss.


Managing an EV charging infrastructure shouldn't be a full-time job. VOOL Portal is the command centre to manage all the EV charging in an apartment or office building. The VOOL Portal enables you to get an overview of charging sessions, consumption, costs and savings and create automatic reports for your end customers.

Our mobile app for the end user integrates with the vehicle and will automatically monitor the market's electricity prices to charge the car when it's the cheapest. If the user decides not to go for the lower price, we won't interfere and will not abort the session. These rules are easy to set up.

Got you interested?

Make sure to visit us at Elmässan Expo or get in touch via e-mail. We'd love to hear from you!

VOOL will be at Elmässan expo on 16-17 October 2024. Meet us at stand H:20!
